description.short_caption: MRI of the lumbar spine showing abnormal signal intensity and structural changes.
description.detailed_description: This is a sagittal MRI of the lumbar spine. The image shows abnormal signal intensity in the lower lumbar vertebrae and intervertebral discs, with evidence of structural changes such as vertebral body destruction and disc space narrowing. These findings are consistent with an infectious or inflammatory process, such as discitis or osteomyelitis. The arrows highlight the affected regions, emphasizing the pathological changes.
visible_findings: abnormal signal intensity in lumbar vertebrae

description.short_caption: MRI of sacroiliac joint showing inflammation and edema.
description.detailed_description: This axial MRI image of the pelvis highlights the sacroiliac joints bilaterally. The arrows point to areas of hyperintensity on the T2-weighted sequence, consistent with inflammation and edema in the sacroiliac joints. The surrounding soft tissues appear unremarkable, and no significant bony destruction is visible.

This sagittal T2-weighted MRI image of the abdomen demonstrates a focal, well-defined, saccular dilation of the infrarenal aorta (indicated by arrows). The aneurysm appears as a rounded structure with altered signal intensity compared to the surrounding tissues. The vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs are visible in the background, providing anatomical context.
visible_findings: saccular dilation of the infrarenal aorta
vertebral bodies and intervertebral discs in the background

description.short_caption: Ultrasound with Doppler showing an abdominal aortic aneurysm.
description.detailed_description: This is a Doppler ultrasound image of the abdominal aorta. The image shows a dilated aortic lumen with turbulent blood flow, indicated by the red and orange Doppler signals. The aneurysmal dilation is evident, with irregular flow patterns suggesting possible turbulence or altered hemodynamics. The surrounding soft tissue appears relatively normal.
visible_findings: turbulent blood flow with Doppler signal

description.short_caption: Histopathology of resected aorta showing inflammatory changes.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a section of the aorta with prominent inflammatory changes. There are areas of dense inflammatory infiltrates, with regions of necrosis and disruption of normal tissue architecture. The pink-stained areas represent connective tissue, while the darker purple regions indicate inflammatory cell clusters. The image suggests a pathological process involving significant inflammation, possibly infectious or autoimmune in nature.
